title: Online Booking vs. Phone Calls for Appointments

bars.label: Percentage of Small Businesses Overwhelmed by Phone Calls
Increase in Bookings with Online Booking

narration: This chart highlights the significant time savings and efficiency gains achievable by transitioning from relying solely on phone calls for scheduling to implementing an online booking system. The data reveals that small business owners spend a substantial amount of time – 15 to 20 hours per week – answering phone calls, while online booking can save up to 12 hours.  A large majority (68%) feel overwhelmed by the volume of calls, and a clear majority (71%) prefer booking appointments online, demonstrating a shift in consumer behavior.
